_doc: The Challenge's places (tools/ch-art/plates.py). from / from_night: the user's painting in Downloads/Challenge-art/to-edit. spot: the plate's name in assets/sets/ch. hours: which hours exist. night: 'auto' (nightify repaints the day) or 'painted' (the user painted the night). Coordinates are 1600x900 reference px of the imported src. marks: {kind, x, y, h?, hour?, ...} where h = the px one metre takes there (a person is 1.75 h); kinds: stand, seat (group says whose), podium / duel (side L|R), host, gate, gong, dj, plane, spot (a map pin: id names the place). fire [x, foot y, flame h] painted flames (heat shimmer, glow at night). pool [x0,y0,x1,y1, fish, sample x, sample y] still water. fall [x0,y0,x1,y1] falling water. sway / cloth / still / glow / wind / noleaf / nosky / critters as in tools/td-camp/traced/places.json.
